A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Neimoidian''' from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]] was one of the aides of [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Merillion Tarko]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] at the [[Tarko-se Arena]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tarko-se/Legends|Tarko-se]], which was located on the [[purse world]]. He had [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], green skin, no [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and wore a brown head-dress and tan, decorative clothing.<ref name="TFUII" />

==Biography==
In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="TFUIIComic">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (graphic novel)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'' graphic novel]]</ref> the aide was at the arena when the blind [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]], who had been captured by on a failed [[Raid on Cato Neimoidia|raid]] on the purse world,<ref name="TFU2 (novel)">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'' novelization]]</ref> was being forced to fight a number of [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiators]] and beasts in [[Tarko-se Arena]] for the pleasure of the local [[Moff/Legends|Moff]], [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Merillion Tarko]]. When [[Subject 1138|Starkiller]], a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of [[Galen Marek]], reached Cato Neimoidia in a [[TIE Advanced x1/Legends|TIE Advanced x1]] to free Kota, the Neimoidian notified Tarko,<ref name="TFUII" /> misidentifying the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of the ship as the [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. The aide was then instructed by the Baron to assemble a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] to greet the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]].<ref name="TFU2 (novel)" />

==Behind the scenes==
This Neimoidian aide first appeared in [[Sean Williams]]' novel [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (novelization)|''The Force Unleashed II'']], published on [[October 5]], [[2010]]. The aide appeared a second time in the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'', released on [[October 26]] of the same [[Standard year/Legends|year]].
